topography.project_purpose: ELYFI is a decentralized protocol that bridges real-world assets (RWA) into DeFi by tokenizing them into on-chain assets. It enables users to deposit tokenized RWAs as collateral to borrow stablecoins or earn yield through lending pools.
topography.relationship_narrative: The ELYFI family shares the MoneyPool proxy, which uses the Validation implementation for core logic. The ElyfiToken likely serves as a governance or incentive token across the LToken lending pools, while the unnamed contracts provide infrastructure such as access control or pool management.
